changelog: **Notification bell accessible name:** `NotificationBell`'s `aria-label` now carries the unread badge text ("Notifications 3", "Notifications 9+"), so the visible label is part of the accessible name (WCAG 2.5.3, axe `label-content-name-mismatch`). Cleared the `a11y-scan.spec.ts` regression on `/portal` and `/messages`.

en: Screen readers now announce the number of unread notifications on the notification bell.
tr: Ekran okuyucular artık bildirim zilindeki okunmamış bildirim sayısını da okuyor.
de: Screenreader sagen an der Benachrichtigungsglocke jetzt auch die Anzahl ungelesener Benachrichtigungen an.
